propositions: Cumulative error counters in observability.sh advance their offset file before CloudWatch publish succeeds, so a transient AWS failure causes the next interval to compute zero from the already-advanced baseline, permanently losing the positive delta.

All seven affected metric streams (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, and G2P) share the same defect: offset persisted before aws cloudwatch put-metric-data acknowledges delivery.
Offset must advance only after successful CloudWatch publication; on failure it should remain unchanged so the next run retries the accumulated delta.

Regression test observes RED before fix (offset advances and next run publishes 0), GREEN after fix (offset held on failure, retry publishes delta), and RED when pre-acknowledgement mutation restored.
